proposed_facts.reason: Canonical construction searches the mixed list before testing HSD_TE_0, whose header encoding is 7. Stored external pointers, reference and placement initialization, and downstream assignment match the proposal.
Compilation uses forced TEV cleanup followed by selective constant cleanup. The constant reference guard and material compile/setup caller confirm that referenced constants survive for later uploads.

FreeList literally repeats the c_ref test and calls Unref with 1 then 5. Only 1 selects color. The recursive release guard tests the resulting zero state, without detecting a first transition or marking released dependencies.

The complete upload function confirms uninitialized local colors, unsigned RGB U32 versus signed-int scalar conversion, floating conversion before clamping, channel routing, and upload loops excluding slot 7. Numeric and reachability uncertainties are appropriately preserved.

The header declares constant references as u8 and TEV references as s32. Unref guards against decrementing zero, recursively visits all eight dependencies whenever both TEV counts are zero, and neither frees storage nor clears child pointers.

Lowering explicitly exempts alpha operation values 8–13 from the zero-color-reference default condition. Default fields, destination assertions, previous-register flags, literal descriptor initialization and caller-owned stage numbering match canonical code; GX definitions confirm unit scale.
